t: A free language for numerical computing with plotting and linear algebra tools.
steps: Find GNU Octave on its official site.
Install from a Windows installer, Homebrew, MacPorts, or a Linux package.
Ask IT to approve the install on school computers.
Open Octave and type a simple calculation.
Read the Introduction to GNU Octave open textbook.
Plot a function and save the figure.
Test one lesson on a single computer first.
